title: The Foundry
author: Odessa Kiln, Kiln & Co. Salvage
pages: I locked the warehouse with Rudy inside. He came back from the ridge with a cough, and by morning he was taller than the door.
He kept working the foundry even after his hands stopped being hands. If you are at the warehouse, my office is upstairs. Don't go down to the casting floor. That isn't Rudy anymore.
